misclassified_entities.reason: Calling contracts are internal EVM components within the same execution context. A contract calling a precompile is not external to the system - it's part of the internal call stack. The call originates from already-validated, executing code within the EVM sandbox.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain Consensus Layer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: The beacon chain is a separate consensus layer system that proposes execution payloads. While it has undergone validation at the consensus layer, the execution layer must still verify block structure, state roots, and transaction validity. Cross-layer trust boundary exists.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain Validator
trusted_external_entities.rationale: PoS validators propose and attest to blocks. They have economic stake (32+ ETH) at risk and are authenticated via BLS signatures, but their proposed blocks must still pass all execution layer validation checks.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External accounts submitting EIP-1559 transactions. All transaction data must be fully validated: signature recovery, nonce matching, fee constraints (max_fee >= priority_fee), balance sufficiency, EOA verification. No implicit trust.

trusted_external_entities.name: Decentralized Application
trusted_external_entities.rationale: dApps requesting wallet permissions via JSON-RPC. Must not be trusted - can request arbitrary permissions. User consent is required for all permission grants. Origin verification critical to prevent spoofing.

trusted_external_entities.name: dApp Caller
trusted_external_entities.rationale: dApp attempting to call wallet methods. All method calls must be checked against permission store. Permission existence and caveat validation required before method execution.

trusted_external_entities.name: Querying dApp
trusted_external_entities.rationale: dApp querying its current permissions via wallet_getPermissions. Permissions must be filtered by invoker - dApp should only see its own permissions, not others'.

trusted_external_entities.name: Potentially Malicious dApp
trusted_external_entities.rationale: dApp that may attempt SSRF attacks via crafted URLs in permission requests. All URLs must be validated against scheme and port whitelists to prevent local service access.

trusted_external_entities.name: Hex Input Source
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External source of hexadecimal strings (JSON-RPC, config files, test data). Input may contain invalid characters, missing prefix, or malformed data. No validation assumptions - caller must handle errors.

trusted_external_entities.name: Integer Input Source
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External source providing hex-encoded integers (gas values, block numbers). May provide values that overflow target types (U8, U64, U256). Type bounds checking required after parsing.

trusted_external_entities.name: Untrusted Input Source
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Generic source of potentially malformed or malicious hex strings at system boundary. Must enforce fixed-size output constraints via padding to prevent length-related vulnerabilities.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Beacon chain provides execution payload. Execution layer must validate: sequential block number, increasing timestamp, gas limits within bounds, zero difficulty, zero nonce, empty ommers hash, state/tx/receipt roots.
Validator proposed/attested to block. Must verify PoS consensus requirements: difficulty=0, nonce=0, ommers_hash=EMPTY_OMMER_HASH. Validator has 32+ ETH at stake.

Transaction from untrusted sender. Must validate: available gas, sender recovery from signature, nonce match, max_fee_per_gas >= max_priority_fee_per_gas, balance >= gas*max_fee + value, sender is EOA.
dApp requests wallet permissions. Must verify origin/invoker to prevent spoofing. User consent required via prompt UI. Permission grant must include caveat restrictions.
dApp calls wallet method. Must check if method requires permission. If restricted, look up permission by invoker and parentCapability. Validate all caveats before allowing execution.
dApp queries permissions. Must filter results by invoker - return only permissions where invoker matches the calling dApp's origin. Prevents information leakage about other dApps.

URL in permission request may be malicious SSRF attempt. Must validate: scheme in whitelist (http, https), port in whitelist (block access to local services on unusual ports). Block file://, localhost URLs.
External hex string input. May have invalid characters (not 0-9, a-f, A-F), missing or malformed 0x prefix. Python int()/Bytes.fromhex() will raise ValueError - caller must handle exceptions.
Hex-encoded integer from external source. After parsing, value must be bounds-checked against target type (U8: 0-255, U64: 0-2^64-1, U256: 0-2^256-1). Type wrapper constructors enforce bounds.

Untrusted hex at system boundary. Fixed-size outputs (Bytes8, Bytes32, Bytes256) enforced via right-justify padding with zeros. Prevents length-related vulnerabilities by guaranteeing exact output size.
